review.reviewer: Codex with independent model and JavaScript review agents
review.method: Automatic WebGL render sweep plus sampled visual contact sheets, model close-ups, native game interactions and geometry/collision regression tests.

environment.scope: Seven environment generators and the complete 45-entry catalogue reviewed in actual WebGL and game placement; earlier 38-entry baseline review retained.

referenceBoard.notes: Fixed-angle visual reference for palette, proportions and low-poly style; runtime geometry is authored separately.

technicalFrame.worldScale: Rooms are 12x10 world units; measured dimensions are local to each constructor.
technicalFrame.texturePolicy: No external texture dependency; authored labels use CanvasTexture and normalized-UV thin boxes.
technicalFrame.materialPolicy: Shared muted matte palette; dull brass metalness .28 roughness .6; glass/water transparencies only where authored.
technicalFrame.pivotPolicy: Per-entry pivot classification and measured local bounds are authoritative.
technicalFrame.collisionPolicy: Explicit local assetColliders transformed to world; mobile actors use separate circles.
technicalFrame.resourcePolicy: Geometry and material factories register shared resources; dispose on owning scene/gallery teardown, never on removing a shared instance.
technicalFrame.mergePolicy: Static direct-child meshes merged by material inside each group; keepMesh preserves mutable leaf handles and child pivots remain separate.
